title: WebMCP Safety Check
user: Web teams exposing WebMCP/browser automation tools who need to inspect which operations can mutate state, use a real profile, or access an origin before an agent is allowed to call them.
smallest_useful_product: A browser extension plus CLI that reads a WebMCP/MCP manifest or session transcript, classifies tools by read/mutate/external-navigation/credential scope, and fails CI on missing approval or evidence declarations.
constraints: Treat server declarations as claims, not proof; avoid collecting browser content; track evolving specifications without inventing compatibility guarantees.
